The change is motivated by a specific compatibility issue with iOS cross-compilation, where maturin 1.14.1 introduced a change in how the Python ABI link name is encoded.

This adjustment is consistent with normal packaging and build system maintenance, especially when working around upstream toolchain bugs. The patch does not introduce any network operations, file manipulations, or execution of external code. It solely updates a dependency version range in a configuration file, which is a common and safe practice in software packaging.

There is no obfuscated code, suspicious commands, or unexpected behavior in the patch. The change is transparent, minimal, and focused on enabling compatibility with newer versions of a required build tool.
